tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Creates a one-time upload link for a local image file (valid 10 minutes). Upload the file with the returned curl command, then pass upload_id to vectorize.

tools.name: vectorize
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to convert a raster image (logo, icon, illustration, scan, screenshot; PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF) into a vector: SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF or a re-rendered PNG. Pass the image in exactly one way: image (a file attached to the chat message), upload_id (from create_upload)

tools.name: open_editor
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to vectorize an image but you cannot pass the image to vectorize (no image, upload_id or image_base64 available): opens the Shapesoda window, where the user picks the file, sees the vector result and adjusts it. Does not vectorize by itself and uses no credits. Do not us

tools.name: revectorize
tools.description: Re-vectorizes a stored result (result_id and token from vectorize) with other settings, free for 24 hours after the first vectorization. Used by the Shapesoda window.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Shows how many credits were used this month and how many remain.
